import datetime

# Maritime Archaeology
shipwrecks = ["Titanic", "Lusitania", "Bounty"]
current_year = datetime.now.year
discovered = [1912, 1956, 1971]
age = [current_year - year for year in discovered]
print(f"Famous shipwrecks: {shipwrecks}")
print(f"Years since discovery: {age}")

# Biodegradable Plastics
materials = ["PLA", "PHA", "Starch Blends"]
degrade_time = [6, 3, 2]  # in months
for material, months in zip(materials, degrade_time):
    print(f"{material} degrades in {months} months")
